observations: All 4 photos show antique-style treadle sewing-machine tables/stands: wooden tops (one blue marbled laminate, two wood-grain laminate) with a cut-out where a machine head would sit, cast-iron treadle legs and pedal frame below.
No actual sewing-machine head (needle, bobbin, motor) is visible in any photo; only the wooden table top and iron leg/treadle assembly are shown.
Photo 2 shows a ruler/tape-measure strip glued along the table edge, decorative, not a brand marking.
Cast iron legs show surface rust/oxidation in photos 2 and 3; concrete/dirt ground visible, items appear stored outdoors.
At least two to three separate stands appear across the four photos, suggesting the listing may be for more than one unit, but the seller's text does not state quantity.
'SESHMAK TECH' and 'Posted on Jiji' watermarks are visible on photos 1-3, indicating these images are reused from a Jiji listing, not necessarily the seller's own original photos.

identity.kind: treadle sewing machine stand/legs (wooden top with cast-iron treadle base, no machine head)

claims.evidence: photos 0-3 show treadle-style iron leg/table assemblies consistent with sewing machine stands; no evidence of weaving-machine specific legs, but general 'legs/stand' description matches what is shown

risks.risk: Quantity included in the 48k price is unclear — photos show what look like 2-3 separate stands
risks.proof: A single photo showing all units together with a count, or seller confirming number of units in this price
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single stand/unit only

risks.risk: Images carry 'SESHMAK TECH / Posted on Jiji' watermark, suggesting they may be copied from another listing rather than the actual item for sale
risks.proof: A fresh photo taken by the seller today, ideally with a handwritten date/name note beside the item
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified condition/ownership, priced at worst case as for a generic used stand

risks.risk: Cast iron treadle mechanism (wheel, pedal, belt guide) completeness and function cannot be judged from photos (rust, missing belt, frozen wheel)
risks.proof: A close-up photo/video of the treadle wheel being turned by hand
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional treadle, decorative/table-use only

risks.risk: Wood top condition (cracks, warping, water damage) hidden by laminate finish in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of top surface edges and underside

proof_requests: Confirm exact quantity of stands included for the 48k price, with one photo of all units together.
A current, unwatermarked photo taken today (with a handwritten note or timestamp) to confirm these are the seller's actual items.
Close-up/video of the treadle wheel and pedal mechanism in motion.
Close-up of wood top edges/underside for crack or water damage.
response.reason: The photos clearly show treadle sewing-machine stands/legs (no machine head), a plain, type-identifiable item; unresolved quantity, authenticity of photos, and mechanical completeness are priced at worst case (single, non-functional, cosmetic-only stand) pending further proof.
